name: Repair Reason 4 Code
definition: Specifies the reason why the settlement instruction has a repair status.

BATC.name: Processing Batch
BATC.definition: Unrecognised or invalid processing batch, that is, daytime/real-time while only possible to settle in overnight batch.

CAEV.name: Corporate Action
CAEV.definition: Corporate action pending on the financial instrument instructed.

CASY.name: Impossible Cash Settlement System
CASY.definition: Impossible standing arrangements override instruction for the cash settlement system.

DSEC.name: Security
DSEC.definition: Unrecognised or invalid financial instrument identification.

IIND.name: Common Reference
IIND.definition: Unrecognised, invalid or missing common reference.

MINO.name: Minimum Settlement Quantity
MINO.definition: Quantity instructed is lower than the minimum existing settlement quantity for the financial instrument.

MUNO.name: Multiple Settlement Quantity
MUNO.definition: Quantity instructed is not a multiple of an existing settlement quantity lot for the financial instrument.

NCRR.name: Settlement Amount Currency
NCRR.definition: Unrecognised or invalid settlement amount currency.

PHYS.name: Physical Settlement Impossible
PHYS.definition: Physical settlement is impossible for the instructed financial instrument.

PLCE.name: Place Of Trade
PLCE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid place of trade.

REFE.name: Reference
REFE.definition: Instruction has a reference identical to another previously received instruction.

RTGS.name: Impossible To Use The RTGS System Instructed
RTGS.definition: Impossible to use the RTGS system instructed (NRTG or YRTG).

SAFE.name: Safekeeping Account
SAFE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid message sender's safekeeping account.

SETR.name: Settlement Transaction
SETR.definition: Unrecognised or invalid settlement transaction type.

SETS.name: Settlement System Method
SETS.definition: Unrecognised or invalid settlement system/method instructed.

TXST.name: Tax Status
TXST.definition: Unrecognised or invalid tax status of the securities instructed.

INPS.name: Place Of Safekeeping
INPS.definition: Unrecognised, invalid or missing Place of Safekeeping.

SDUT.name: Stamp Duty
SDUT.definition: Required stamp duty information is missing.

IEXE.name: Receiving Delivering Party 3
IEXE.definition: Client of delivering or receiving party 2 mismatch.

ICAG.name: Receiving Delivering Party 1
ICAG.definition: Participant of delivering or receiving depository mismatch.

ICUS.name: Receiving Delivering Party 2
ICUS.definition: Client of delivering or receiving party 1 mismatch.
